# SideSheet

```ts
import { SideSheet } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

Side Sheet is a full-height panel that slides in from the right edge over the modal scrim (Figma hellopc.side.sheet, formerly hellopc.drawer). Use it to view or edit a record without leaving the page — a contact, a device, a ticket. Use Modal for a short, centred decision ("Delete this file?"), and an inline page section when the content should not block the rest of the page.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `boolean` | — | Controlled open state. Pair with onOpenChange. |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | `false` | Initial open state for uncontrolled usage. |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` | — | Fired whenever the sheet requests an open-state change (close, Esc, scrim click). |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Sheet width: sm 400px, md 480px, lg 640px. Never wider than the viewport. Height is always the full viewport. |
| `density` | `'default' \| 'compact'` | `'default'` | default — 20/24px header, 20px title, 48px tabs, 24px content inset. compact — 12/16px header, 16px title, ~36px tabs, 16px content inset; about 50px more room for content. |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` | **required** | Visible heading, rendered through Radix Dialog.Title (the sheet's accessible name). |
| `description` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Optional supporting line under the title, rendered through Radix Dialog.Description. |
| `headerAction` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Optional slot before the close control — typically one Button size="sm" (e.g. "Edit"). |
| `tabs` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Optional tab bar: HorizontalTabItem elements. When set, the body is wrapped in HorizontalTabs, so children should be the matching HorizontalTabsContent panels. Tabs inherit the sheet's density. |
| `tabsLabel` | `string` | `'Sections'` | Accessible name for the tab bar. |
| `tabValue` | `string` | — | Selected tab (controlled). Pair with onTabChange. |
| `defaultTabValue` | `string` | — | Initially selected tab (uncontrolled). Defaults to the first tab's value. |
| `onTabChange` | `(value: string) => void` | — | Fired with the newly selected tab's value. |
| `footer` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Optional footer actions, right-aligned above a top rule — typically "Cancel" (variant="outline" intent="secondary") then "Save" (fill), both size="sm". Rendered through ModalFooter. |
| `closeLabel` | `string` | `'Close'` | Accessible name for the close control. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | — | The scrolling content slot (or the tab panels when tabs is set). |


## Usage

```tsx
<SideSheet open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} title="Contact details">…</SideSheet>
<SideSheet title="Contact details" description="Last edited today" … />
<SideSheet title="Contact details" headerAction={<Button size="sm">Edit</Button>} … />
<SideSheet title="Contact details" size="lg" … />
<SideSheet title="Contact details" density="compact" … />
<SideSheet title="Contact details" footer={<><Button size="sm" variant="outline" intent="secondary">Cancel</Button><Button size="sm">Save</Button></>} … />
<SideSheet title="Contact details" tabs={<><HorizontalTabItem value="overview">Overview</HorizontalTabItem>…</>}><HorizontalTabsContent value="overview">…</HorizontalTabsContent></SideSheet>
```

## Accessibility

- Radix Dialog gives the dialog role with aria-modal, the focus trap, initial focus inside the sheet, scroll lock, Esc and scrim dismissal, and focus return to the trigger.
- title renders through Dialog.Title, so it names the dialog; description renders through Dialog.Description. When there is no description the aria-describedby link is removed rather than left dangling.
- The close control is an IconButton with an accessible name — set closeLabel when "Close" is not specific enough (e.g. "Close contact details").
- The scrolling content area is a keyboard-focusable region named by the title, so keyboard users can scroll read-only content with the arrow keys. It shows the standard focus ring.
- The tab bar is a full Radix tablist (Left/Right, Home/End). Name it with tabsLabel.
- The slide-in animation is turned off under prefers-reduced-motion.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Use a side sheet to view or edit one record in context. | Use it for a quick yes/no decision — use Modal. |
| Keep one primary action in the footer ("Save"), after "Cancel". | Stack several primary buttons in the header and footer. |
| Use density="compact" for long forms in dense, data-heavy screens. | Mix densities between the header, tabs and footer. |
| Give the close control a specific closeLabel when several sheets exist. | Remove every way to close the sheet. |
